name: Pravin Smart Content Scheduler
author: Pravin Karmur

sections.description:
Pravin Smart Content Scheduler allows you to control when content appears on your WordPress site using a simple shortcode. Perfect for limited-time offers, seasonal content, business hours, and member-exclusive sections.

Features:

  • Schedule content by start/end dates
  • Set specific time ranges (business hours)
  • Restrict content by user roles
  • Timezone support
  • Clean, simple shortcode
  • No database required
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/pravin-smart-content-scheduler/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use Settings → Content Scheduler for documentation
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

Use the shortcode: [pscs_schedule_content start_date="2026-01-15" end_date="2026-01-20"]Your content[/pscs_schedule_content]

Can I schedule by time only?

Yes! Just omit the date parameters and use start_time and end_time.
